name: Slack MCP
tagline: Read channels, post messages, and react from your agent.
shortDescription: The reference Slack MCP server. List channels, read message history, post messages and replies, add reactions, and search across your workspace.
longDescription:
## What it does

Exposes the Slack Web API as MCP tools. Your agent can list public channels, read recent message history, post a new message or reply in a thread, add emoji reactions, and run a workspace-wide search.

## Why we recommend it

It's the most useful 'let my agent ping the team' tool there is. Pair it with a monitoring or CI workflow and your agent can DM you when something goes wrong, post a status update when a deploy finishes, or summarize yesterday's standup.

## What it does NOT do

DM history of users you don't share a channel with. Slack's permission model is strict; this server respects it.
installInstructions:
1. Create a Slack app at https://api.slack.com/apps
2. Add the `channels:history`, `channels:read`, `chat:write`, `reactions:write`, and `search:read` scopes
3. Install the app to your workspace
4. Set `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=xoxb-your-token` and `SLACK_TEAM_ID=T01...`
5. Run the install command
